info.name: CrewApply — Auth API
info.description:
Complete authentication test suite for CrewApply.

Workflow:
1. Register → copy verification token from email/console
2. Verify Email → account is now active
3. Login → accessToken and refreshToken are auto-saved
4. Use protected routes → Authorization header is auto-set
5. Refresh Tokens → new tokens auto-saved
6. Logout / Logout All

All tokens are stored automatically via collection-level test scripts.
